title: Wedding DJ Clash Sparks Violence in Muzaffarpur
summary: A dispute over a wedding DJ's performance escalated into violence at a recent wedding in Muzaffarpur, Bihar. The incident occurred when the bride and groom's families disagreed on the type of music to be played during the ceremony. Local authorities have launched an investigation into the matter.
summary_points: A dispute over a wedding DJ's performance led to violence at a recent wedding in Muzaffarpur, Bihar.
The incident occurred when the bride and groom's families disagreed on the type of music to be played during the ceremony.
Local authorities have launched an investigation into the matter.
The clash involved members from both sides of the wedding party.
No injuries or fatalities were reported in the incident.
